title: The First Model of SSI, Founded by Former OpenAI Chief Scientist Ilya, is Exposed

content_html:
Artificial intelligence has once again seen a major breakthrough. After leaving OpenAI as the chief scientist, Ilya Sutskever founded SSI (Safe Superintelligence), which has now released some details about its first model. According to recent revelations from multiple netizens on overseas social platforms, the institution is currently exploring a small reasoning engine based on TTT (Training While Testing), marking a significant step forward in its path toward safe superintelligence.

According to the information, the core of this new architecture lies in teaching the model "how to learn." Unlike traditional large models, where parameters remain unchanged during inference, this engine can dynamically update certain model weights while solving real problems. This design highly aligns with Ilya's core views, that true superintelligence should not rely solely on static training, but rather have the ability to continuously learn and evolve after deployment. Although TTT technology has long faced significant security challenges, it is reported that relevant technical difficulties have been resolved.

In terms of release schedule, this version of the model may be available for testing by a select group of invited users as early as August this year. Additionally, the next generation of the model is expected to scale up by 10 times. Although SSI has remained highly secretive so far, the content revealed this time closely matches previous industry clues regarding its technical roadmap, technical progress, and collaborations with giants like NVIDIA. With this new concept taking shape, the artificial intelligence industry may soon see a disruptive product capable of "changing tactics on the spot."

content_html_zh:
人工智能再次取得重大突破。 在辞去 OpenAI 首席科学家职务后，Ilya Sutskever 创立了 SSI（安全超级智能），目前该公司已经发布了有关其第一个模型的一些细节。 据海外社交平台多位网友近期爆料，该机构目前正在探索基于TTT（Training While Test）的小型推理引擎，标志着其在安全超级智能的道路上迈出了重要一步。

据了解，这个新架构的核心在于教授模型“如何学习”。 与传统大型模型在推理过程中参数保持不变不同，该引擎可以在解决实际问题的同时动态更新某些模型权重。 这一设计与Ilya的核心观点高度契合，即真正的超级智能不应该仅仅依赖于静态训练，而应该具有部署后不断学习和进化的能力。 尽管TTT技术长期以来面临重大安全挑战，但据悉相关技术难点已经得到解决。

就发布时间表而言，该版本的模型最早可能会在今年 8 月由一组选定的受邀用户进行测试。 此外，下一代模型的规模预计将扩大 10 倍。 尽管SSI至今仍保持高度机密，但此次透露的内容与之前的行业线索非常吻合，无论是其技术路线、技术进展，还是与NVIDIA等巨头的合作。 随着这一新概念的形成，人工智能行业或许很快就会看到一款能够“当场改变战术”的颠覆性产品。
